_comment: Armor is flat subtraction scaled by armor_mult. class_mult keys match enemy.armor_class. shield_mult applies while an enemy's shield pool is up -- it is the multiplier on damage that is about to be absorbed, so it decides how expensive it is to strip the barrier rather than how much health is lost. damage_floor guarantees no matchup is fully immune.
_shield_comment: Only the Bulwark has a shield, so these numbers affect exactly one enemy and nothing else. The spread is deliberately wide: physical 0.5 vs energy 1.5 is a 3x swing, which is what makes "bring a tesla" a real answer rather than a marginal one. Poison sits near 1.0 because it is a damage-over-time type and a pool that refills already counters chip damage on its own.
